label: Waved albatross, animal 3275-30662
label_line: Recorded movements of one breeding adult, 23 June to 15 September 2008.
title: Galapagos Albatrosses (the study's name on Movebank)
place: Galápagos (tagged at Punta Cevallos, the source's site name) and the eastern Pacific towards Peru
citation_as_given: Cruz, S., Proaño, C.B., Anderson, D., Huyvaert, K., Wikelski, M., 2013, Data from: The Environmental-Data Automated Track Annotation (Env-DATA) System--Linking animal tracks with environmental data: Movebank Data Repository. doi:10.5441/001/1.3hp3s250
paper_citation_as_given: Dodge, S., Bohrer, G., Weinzierl, R., Davidson, S.C., Kays, R., Douglas, D., Cruz, S., Han, J., Brandes, D., Wikelski, M., 2013, The Environmental-Data Automated Track Annotation (Env-DATA) System--Linking animal tracks with environmental data: Movement Ecology, v. 1:3. doi:10.1186/2051-3933-1-3
method: GPS tag (e-obs, 22 g), a fix attempted every 90 minutes; read out wirelessly (reference file)
time_convention: Times are as recorded by the study: UTC, or GPS time, which differs from UTC by a few leap seconds (source README). Mother Earth rounds each time to the nearest second.
sample_sentence: One of 28 birds tagged; nine were used in the paper's analysis. These are sample sizes, not a population estimate.

source_file.name: Galapagos Albatrosses.csv
source_file.retrieved: downloaded by Chad on 20 Nov 2026 from the Movebank Data Repository record

reference_file.name: Galapagos Albatrosses-reference-data.csv
reference_file.retrieved: downloaded by Chad on 20 Nov 2026 from the same record

timestamp_rule.rounding: nearest whole second, in integer milliseconds: seconds = (ms + 500) div 1000
timestamp_rule.statement: Times are rounded to the nearest second. A source time more than 25 ms from a whole second stops the build.

gap_rule.statement: Mother Earth does not join fixes more than 3 hours 15 minutes apart, and never joins across a withheld fix. These are display rules of Mother Earth's, not part of the study.
gap_rule.owner: Mother Earth (display rule; not supplied by the researchers)

withholding.boundary: a fix at exactly the radius or closer is withheld
withholding.centre_source: the reference file's deployment coordinates for this animal, as given (two decimals)
withholding.owner: Mother Earth (a project omission rule; not a scientifically established protection distance and not a guarantee of safety)

sensitivity: Private preview only. Fixes within 5 km of the tagging-site reference point are withheld; every other recorded fix is shown at the source's precision. Public release needs a recorded, dataset-specific sensitivity decision.
